characters.name: Titania
characters.appearance: Tall mature woman, warm olive skin, long deep auburn hair in flowing waves, defined cheekbones, almond hazel eyes, long straight nose, composed expressive mouth. A small gold leaf circlet and turquoise drop earrings repeat.
characters.costume: Opaque jewel-magenta wrap gown, fitted waist, gold vine embroidery, bare shoulders with a covered neckline, elegant calf/side slit, gold sandals. Same gown and identifying colours in P01/P05.

characters.name: Helena
characters.appearance: Tall mature woman, pale warm freckled skin, long honey-blonde hair with one braid running from her temple, long oval face, grey-blue eyes, arched brows, refined nose. Small sapphire hair clasp repeats.
characters.costume: Opaque sapphire-blue gown, turquoise trailing outer overskirt, gold waist sash, covered neckline, bare shoulders, tasteful side slit and blue flat slippers. Same colours/features in P02/P04.

characters.name: Hermia
characters.appearance: Shorter mature woman, rich warm brown skin, shoulder-length dark chestnut curls partly tied back, angular oval face, strong expressive brows, dark brown eyes, defined nose and lips. A ruby flower pin repeats.
characters.costume: Opaque emerald gown, ruby sash and narrow gold trim, fitted covered bodice, draped sleeve/shawl, no underwear or intimate exposure. Same colours/features in P03/P04.

characters.name: Puck
characters.appearance: Lean unmistakably mature adult man, warm tan skin, curly dark hair, defined adult jaw, pointed leaf-like ears, amused attentive eyes. No childlike proportions.
characters.costume: Opaque violet-and-teal leaf-patterned tunic, fitted trousers and brown boots; secondary court figure on branch in P05.
